properties.Script Body:
/**
 * NiFi ExecuteScript: OpenSky state vectors -> canonical horus-events Kafka messages.
 *
 * Input:  FlowFile body = OpenSky JSON from InvokeHTTP
 *         GET https://opensky-network.org/api/states/all?extended=1
 *         { "time": <unix s>, "states": [ [18 fields], ... ] }
 * Output: one FlowFile per airborne aircraft, in the same envelope the adsb.lol
 *         flow emits (schema_version 1), so the gateway, Flink and the lake need
 *         no changes.
 *
 * Source of truth for the script body in nifi/HORUS_Flights_OpenSky.json; that
 * flow file is generated by tools/build_opensky_flow.py.
 *
 * State vector fields (OpenSky REST docs):
 *   0 icao24, 1 callsign, 2 origin_country, 3 time_position, 4 last_contact,
 *   5 longitude, 6 latitude, 7 baro_altitude (m), 8 on_ground, 9 velocity (m/s),
 *   10 true_track (deg), 11 vertical_rate (m/s), 12 sensors, 13 geo_altitude (m),
 *   14 squawk, 15 spi, 16 position_source, 17 category (with extended=1)
 *
 * Notes:
 *   - The timestamp is the aircraft's own position time (time_position), not the
 *     time NiFi ran, so the same position seen twice de-duplicates in Flink.
 *   - OpenSky reports category 0 ("no information") for most aircraft and has no
 *     type code or registration, so classification is by callsign:
 *       military   = UAV / high-performance category, or a military callsign prefix
 *       commercial = airline-style callsign (three letters + digits)
 *       private    = anything else (registration-style callsigns such as N123AB)
 *     'jet' needs type codes; it returns once the OpenSky aircraft database is
 *     used for enrichment.
 *   - Explicit list indexing and f['key'] access throughout (bean-accessor trap).
 */
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

// Positions older than this (seconds, relative to the response time) are dropped.
def MAX_POSITION_AGE_S = 90

// Military callsign prefixes (transport, tanker, VIP and air force call signs).
// Checked before the airline pattern, because several are three letters + digits.
def MIL_CALLSIGN_RE = ~/^(RCH|REACH|KING|DUKE|EVAC|JAKE|CONVOY|CNV|SPAR|SAM|NAVY|ARMY|ASCOT|RRR|GAF|IAM|BAF|CFC|NATO|LAGR|FORTE|HOMER)\d/
def AIRLINE_CODE_RE = ~/^([A-Z]{3})\d/

// OpenSky emitter categories
def CAT_ROTORCRAFT = 8
def CAT_HIGH_PERF = 7
def CAT_UAV = 14
def SKIP_CATEGORIES = [15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20] as Set   // space vehicle, ground vehicles, obstacles
def PRIVATE_CATEGORIES = [2, 9, 12] as Set             // light, glider, ultralight

def ISO = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'")
def iso = { long epochSeconds -> Instant.ofEpochSecond(epochSeconds).atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC).format(ISO) }

def payload = new JsonSlurper().parseText(session.read(flowFile).text)
def responseTime = (payload?.get('time') ?: Instant.now().epochSecond) as long
def states = (payload?.get('states')) ?: []

def capturedAt = iso(Instant.now().epochSecond)
def ingestRunId = flowFile.getAttribute('ingest.run.id') ?: ('nifi-' + UUID.randomUUID().toString().take(12))
def provider  = 'opensky'
def feed      = 'flights'
def sourceUrl = flowFile.getAttribute('invokehttp.request.url') ?: 'https://opensky-network.org/api/states/all'
def emitted = 0
def skipped = 0

states.each { s ->
    if (!(s instanceof List) || s.size() < 17) { skipped++; return }
    def hex       = ((s[0] ?: '') as String).toLowerCase()
    def callsign  = ((s[1] ?: '') as String).trim().toUpperCase()
    def timePos   = s[3]
    def lon       = s[5]
    def lat       = s[6]
    def baroAlt   = s[7]
    def onGround  = s[8] as Boolean
    def velocity  = s[9]
    def track     = s[10]
    def geoAlt    = s[13]
    def squawk    = s[14]
    def posSource = s[16]
    def cat       = (s.size() > 17 && s[17] instanceof Number) ? (s[17] as Integer) : 0

    if (!hex || lat == null || lon == null || timePos == null) { skipped++; return }
    if (onGround) { skipped++; return }
    if (SKIP_CATEGORIES.contains(cat)) { skipped++; return }
    if (responseTime - (timePos as long) > MAX_POSITION_AGE_S) { skipped++; return }

    def name = callsign ?: hex
    def altMeters = (baroAlt instanceof Number) ? (baroAlt as Double)
                  : ((geoAlt instanceof Number) ? (geoAlt as Double) : 0.0d)
    def speedKnots = (velocity instanceof Number) ? (Math.round((velocity as Double) * 1.943844 * 10) / 10.0d) : null
    def heading = (track instanceof Number) ? (track as Double) : 0.0d

    def airlineMatch = AIRLINE_CODE_RE.matcher(callsign)
    def airlineCode = airlineMatch.find() ? airlineMatch.group(1) : ''

    def category = 'private'
    if (cat == CAT_UAV || cat == CAT_HIGH_PERF || MIL_CALLSIGN_RE.matcher(callsign).find()) {
        category = 'military'
    } else if (airlineCode && !PRIVATE_CATEGORIES.contains(cat)) {
        category = 'commercial'
    }

    def entity = [
        id            : hex,
        name          : name,
        domain        : 'AIR',
        entityType    : 'FLIGHT',
        position      : [lat: lat as Double, lng: lon as Double, alt: altMeters],
        threat        : (category == 'military') ? 'LOW' : 'NONE',
        classification: 'UNCLASSIFIED',
        confidence    : 0.9,
        timestamp     : iso(timePos as long),
        source        : [
            provider  : provider,
            feed      : feed,
            originalId: hex,
            confidence: 0.9,
            sourceUrl : sourceUrl,
        ],
        properties    : [
            callsign         : name,
            category         : category,            // commercial | private | military
            aircraft_category: (cat == CAT_ROTORCRAFT) ? 'heli' : 'plane',
            model            : 'Unknown',            // not in OpenSky live data
            icao24           : hex,
            registration     : 'N/A',                // not in OpenSky live data
            squawk           : (squawk ?: ''),
            airline_code     : airlineCode,
            heading          : Math.round(heading),
            speed_knots      : speedKnots,
            grounded         : false,
            origin_country   : (s[2] ?: ''),
            position_source  : posSource,
            emitter_category : cat,
        ],
    ]

    def traceId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
    def envelope = [
        schema_version: 1,
        trace_id      : traceId,
        ingest_run_id : ingestRunId,
        source        : feed,
        captured_at   : capturedAt,
        entity        : entity,
    ]

    def out = session.create(flowFile)
    out = session.write(out, { outStream ->
        outStream.write(JsonOutput.toJson(envelope).getBytes('UTF-8'))
    } as OutputStreamCallback)
    out = session.putAttribute(out, 'mime.type', 'application/json')
    out = session.putAttribute(out, 'kafka.key', hex)
    out = session.putAttribute(out, 'trace.id', traceId)
    session.transfer(out, REL_SUCCESS)
    emitted++
}

if (emitted == 0) {
    log.warn("No flight entities emitted from OpenSky payload (${states.size()} states, ${skipped} skipped)")
    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_FAILURE)
} else {
    log.info("Emitted ${emitted} flight entities from OpenSky (${skipped} skipped)")
    session.remove(flowFile)
}
